lens.name: DPWH district engineering office lens
lens.authority: DEO2LEG/README.md — "The one authorized project-level use: the DEO lens"
lens.grouping_unit: The implementing office printed on the source row, mapped through DEO2LEG/outputs/deo_leg_crosswalk.json.
lens.grain: One printed DPWH allocation record; grouped House members counted individually.
lens.stages: HGAB3 · 3rd reading (House) ↔ DBM NEP. The DPWH Transparency API side corroborates but is not a stage and never decides attribution.

tiers.A: The office group serves exactly one district, so the figure is attributable to that district alone.
tiers.B: The office group serves two or more districts. The figure is an undivided range shared with the named co-served districts and is never split.

lens.not_claimed: Nothing here establishes that a representative requested, sponsored, or controlled any project or amount. A card reports what the office that serves that district printed.

dpwh.basis: Every source row prints an implementing office, so records join the crosswalk directly.

fmr.reason: The FMR annex prints no office field; attribution would need a municipality/barangay → district mapping this index does not carry.

hfep.reason: HFEP carries province-level hierarchy only, with no coordinates; multi-district provinces cannot be resolved to a district.

nia.reason: NIA rows carry no coordinates or LGU fields; inventing an office from free text is forbidden by the upstream no_office flag.

office_change.note: Paired rows whose two stages do not agree on one office group: either the implementing office changed between the NEP and the 3rd reading, or one stage printed an office with no district. Published separately so no card books money the other stage did not attribute to it.
